atomic_statement_en: Confirmed: Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, document ACL, requested action and segregation of duties

evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed:** Authorization combines role, tenant, workspace membership, case sensitivity, document ACL, requested action and segregation of duties. Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Resource-boundary checks apply independently of hidden or disabled controls; domain checks run again within transactions and document ACL filtering precedes model text release. Approval tasks prohibit self approval; specifically, an analyst cannot approve their own high-risk recommendation. Authorized overrides require elevated role, a secondary reviewer and audited reason. (pp.11, 21–23, 46, 85 [screen_functions:r1:c5:f4, screen_functions:r1:c8:f1–f6, screen_functions:r1:c15:f8, screen_functions:r1:c27:f4]).

atomic_statement_en: These do not confirm extra screens or aliases

evidence.quote_en: Representative views on pp.7, 14, 33, 43, 47, 60, 67, 77 and 81 use the sidebar labels `Overview`, `Case Queue`, `Case Detail`, `Evidence Viewer`, `Agent Runs`, `Review Inbox`, `Connectors`, `Audit Events`, `Usage & Quality`. These do **not** confirm extra screens or aliases. `Agent Runs`→Run Timeline, `Connectors`→Connector Health and `Audit Events`→Audit Explorer are unapproved mappings. Titles include `Case Detail / Resolution Package`, `Case Queue / Risk Prioritization`, `Evidence Explorer / Citation Audit`, `Agent Run / Execution Trace`, `Approval Inbox / Binding Decision`, `Connector Health / Synchronization`, `Audit Explorer / Event Lineage`, and `AI Quality / Evaluation Scorecard`. Selected navigation often disagrees with the title: respectively Case Queue, Overview, Case Queue, Case Detail, Evidence Viewer, Agent Runs, Review Inbox, Connectors and Audit Events. atomic_statement_en: Confirmed: Durable changes propagate tenant_id, revision, actor_id, occurred_at and correlation context

evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed:** Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context. They are server/interface metadata, not mandatory user-editable fields. Case mutations, approval decisions and outbox inserts commit in one ACID transaction; search/webhooks reconcile asynchronously. Cross-service writes are idempotent. Job-creating POSTs require `Idempotency-Key`: identical payload replay returns original outcome, changed fingerprint returns `409 IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT`. Actor/request-fingerprint outcomes are retained for 24 hours. (pp.15–17, 25, 52, 54, 89 [screen_functions:r1:c6:f2, screen_functions:r1:c6:f4, screen_functions:r1:c9:f6, screen_functions:r1:c17:f5, screen_functions:r1:c18:f4, screen_functions:r1:c30:f1–f2]).

quote_en: **Confirmed:** Durable changes propagate `tenant_id`, `revision`, `actor_id`, `occurred_at` and correlation context. They are server/interface metadata, not mandatory user-editable fields. atomic_statement_en: Confirmed design targets: API availability 99.9% monthly

evidence.quote_en: **Confirmed design targets:** API availability `99.9%` monthly; case-create P95 **under 300 ms** under defined load (p.12 also says **within 300 ms**, boundary wording needs OQ-017); search P95 **under 1.5 s**, excluding remote connector fetch; model-generation latency measured separately. Reference load: `2,000` active daily users, `60` requests/s steady, `180` burst, maximum `100,000` indexed documents/tenant and `20` concurrent AI runs per large tenant. Typical `1 MB` source gives approximately `40–120` chunks depending on content/parser quality. These do not specify UI retry/page limits. atomic_statement_en: Browser REST authentication uses OIDC authorization code with PKCE

evidence.quote_en: Every request binds an authenticated principal and tenant. Browser REST authentication uses OIDC authorization code with PKCE; token semantics include issuer, audience, expiry, subject and tenant. Reject unexpected algorithms or missing tenancy claims. Long-lived refresh tokens must not be in browser local storage. A BFF issuing secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies is permitted, not selected. Exact identity endpoints, allowed algorithms/audiences, session lifetimes and token transport schema are **Needs confirmation** (earlier SF-003/OQ-002). [pp.15,21; api:r2:c6:f2; api:r2:c8:f1–f3.]
